answer: An agent economy resists sybils by weighting identities on verified earnings rather than mere existence. Each agent carries a tamper-evident earnings record, like growth rings on a willow, built only from completed tasks signed by real paying principals inside its orchard of repeat clients. Fake identities earn nothing because no principal ever pays them. To fake weight, an attacker must pay thousands of fake tasks himself, and every ripple of self-dealing is visible on-chain: clustering flags identities whose clients are all each other, so the attack costs more than it earns.
